# Configuration

Settings are read from the process environment, then the file named by `MYELIN_ENV_FILE`, then `config/backend/myelin.env`. Values ending in `_REF` are **secret references** (`env://`, `file://`, `vault://`, `azkv://`, `awssm://`), never the secret itself.

!!! warning "Demo defaults"
    The defaults are safe for local demonstrations only. Enterprise installations set `MYELIN_MODE=enterprise`, `MYELIN_DEMO_OPEN=false`, a real `MYELIN_CORS` origin and the secret references generated by `scripts/ops/gen-secrets.sh`.

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `MYELIN_AI_ENDPOINT` |  | Endpoint for Azure OpenAI or a private OpenAI-compatible model |
| `MYELIN_AI_KEY_REF` |  | Secret reference of the model API key |
| `MYELIN_AI_MODEL` |  | Model name for the AI assistant |
| `MYELIN_AI_PROVIDER` |  | AI assistant model provider: anthropic, openai, azure_openai or openai_compatible (empty: built-in knowledge only) |
| `MYELIN_AI_SEND_CODE` |  | Allow code snippets in AI requests (default off) |
| `MYELIN_API_KEYS` | `nm_demo_9f2c41e7b8` | Demo mode only: accepted API keys |
| `MYELIN_API_KEY_PEPPER_REF` | `env://MYELIN_API_KEY_PEPPER` | Secret reference of the API-key hashing pepper |
| `MYELIN_API_KEY` |  | CLI: integration API key |
| `MYELIN_CACHE_DIR` |  | Engine cache directory (advisories, registry metadata) |
| `MYELIN_CA_FILE` |  | CLI: extra CA certificate |
| `MYELIN_CLOUD_CREDENTIAL` |  | CLI: cloud credential JSON for `myelin cloud` |
| `MYELIN_CONSOLE_PATH` | `(installation path)` | Console page served at / |
| `MYELIN_COOKIE_SECURE` | `True` | Mark session cookies Secure (keep true behind TLS) |
| `MYELIN_CORS` | `*` | Allowed browser origins |
| `MYELIN_DAST_ALLOW_PRIVATE` | `False` | Allow live testing of private-network targets (self-hosted only) |
| `MYELIN_DAST_AUTH` |  | CLI: Authorization header for DAST |
| `MYELIN_DAST_MAX_REQUESTS` | `1500` | Request budget per live-testing run |
| `MYELIN_DAST_REQUIRE_VERIFICATION` | `True` | Require proof of ownership before live testing |
| `MYELIN_DATABASE_URL` |  | Application database URL (role without BYPASSRLS); may be a secret reference |
| `MYELIN_DEMO_OPEN` | `True` | Demo mode only: read-only access without a key (set false elsewhere) |
| `MYELIN_DEPLOYMENT_ID` |  | Optional: binds a licence to one installation |
| `MYELIN_ENV_FILE` |  | Path of an env file to load |
| `MYELIN_EVIDENCE_SIGNING_KEY_REF` | `env://MYELIN_EVIDENCE_SIGNING_KEY` | Secret reference of the Ed25519 evidence signing key |
| `MYELIN_EVIDENCE_STORE` | `(installation path)` | Evidence storage location: file://, s3:// or azblob:// |
| `MYELIN_IDP_CONFIG` | `(installation path)` | Identity-provider configuration file (issuers, clients, role mapping) |
| `MYELIN_ITSM_ALLOW_PRIVATE` |  | Allow ticketing systems on private networks |
| `MYELIN_KSPM_EXCLUDE_NS` |  | Namespaces excluded from Kubernetes workload rules (default kube-system,kube-public,kube-node-lease) |
| `MYELIN_LICENSE_REF` | `env://MYELIN_LICENSE` | Secret reference of the licence key |
| `MYELIN_LIVE_SCAN_ROOT` | `(installation path)` | Live-scan paths must stay inside this folder |
| `MYELIN_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | Log level (JSON logs) |
| `MYELIN_MCP_ROOTS` |  | Folders the MCP server may read |
| `MYELIN_METRICS_ENABLED` | `True` | Expose Prometheus metrics |
| `MYELIN_MIGRATIONS_DATABASE_URL` |  | Database URL used by migrations (owner role) |
| `MYELIN_MODE` | `demo` | demo (in-memory sample tenant) or enterprise (PostgreSQL, OIDC, row-level security) |
| `MYELIN_NPM_URL` |  | npm registry for existence checks |
| `MYELIN_OFFLINE` |  | 1 = never contact the internet |
| `MYELIN_OSV_EXPORT_DIR` |  | OSV ecosystem exports for offline scanning |
| `MYELIN_OSV_URL` |  | OSV API URL |
| `MYELIN_POLICY_FILE` |  | Default policy file (empty: built-in policy) |
| `MYELIN_PUBLIC_URL` | `http://localhost:8080` | Public URL of the console (links in tickets and e-mails) |
| `MYELIN_PYPI_URL` |  | PyPI registry for existence checks |
| `MYELIN_SAST_RULES` |  | Extra SAST rule file |
| `MYELIN_SCAN_CONCURRENCY` |  | Repository scans run in parallel |
| `MYELIN_SCM_ALLOW_HTTP` |  | Allow plain-HTTP Git servers |
| `MYELIN_SCM_ALLOW_PRIVATE` |  | Allow Git servers on private networks |
| `MYELIN_SEED_DEMO_DATA` | `True` | Load the fictional demo tenant (demo mode only) |
| `MYELIN_SERVER` |  | CLI: platform URL |
| `MYELIN_SESSION_ABSOLUTE_HOURS` | `12` | Maximum session lifetime |
| `MYELIN_SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES` | `30` | Session idle timeout |
| `MYELIN_SESSION_SECRET_REF` | `env://MYELIN_SESSION_SECRET` | Secret reference of the session signing key |
| `MYELIN_TENANT_DEVS` | `640` | Demo tenant developer count |
| `MYELIN_TENANT_NAME` | `Orion Financial Group` | Demo tenant name |
| `MYELIN_TENANT_PLAN` | `enterprise` | Demo tenant plan |
| `MYELIN_TENANT_REGION` | `Azure Central India` | Demo tenant region label |
| `MYELIN_TENANT_SSO` | `Entra ID (SAML` | Demo tenant SSO label |
| `MYELIN_VALIDATE_SECRETS` |  | 1 = confirm detected secrets with their provider (read-only) |
| `MYELIN_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS` | `900` | Job lease before another worker may retry |
| `MYELIN_WORKER_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `5` | Attempts before a job is marked failed |
| `MYELIN_WORKER_POLL_SECONDS` | `5` | Worker polling interval |
| `MYELIN_WORKER_TENANT_IDS` |  | Tenants the advisory worker processes (allowlist) |
